events.title: Devs livestream Tribal Towers: Siege of the Shifting Fortress
events.summary: Come watch the developers play live and discuss the game and the features. How different skills work, the impact of equipment load, and what to expect from dungeons!

events.title: Steam Deck compatibility
events.summary: We love the Steam Deck and SteamOS and regularly test the Steam Deck together with high-end PC's. We'll have 3 or more players, using both SteamOS and Windows, seamlessly running dungeons together and having a great time!Tribal Towers : Siege of the Shifting Fortress dynamically switches between controller or keyboard/mouse at just a touch of the controlsFrom handheld to big-screen TV we hope you'll enjoy it as much as we do!

events.title: New Characters Available
events.summary: Something we've wanted to do for a long time has landed at last. Play your favorite style by picking from an array of base characters. How about a hammer wielding Paladin with the ability to heal? Or a staff wielding Wizard with offensive spells and Mana Refund? A classic warrior with a Sword and Shield, and Shield Barrier? There are more, a priest, summoner, berserker, ranger, spearman, and punch and kick throwing monk! It's a lot of fun, and a brand new skill chooser will give you access to it

events.title: Still working hard!
events.summary: Just letting everyone know we are hard at work on this game! There is so much good stuff we're excited to share, but also a number of details to finish polishing. Here are some details - Active Abilities - such as brand new Ice abilities like Blizzard, and many more that we'll save for a demo.Passive Abilities - like Mana Refund, and Shield Barrier have been implemented and are working great!Brand new artwork and levels.A new way of entering each type of themed dungeons.Multiplayer improvements!
